IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD;
END;


WITH TEMP_CustomerAccountSK AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount  
)
,
TEMP_CCD AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId,CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,BranchId,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
),
CustomerAccountPaymentCard AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId, PaymentCardId,  FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode  FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPaymentCard WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
),
PaymentCard AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PaymentCardId, PaymentCardIssuedDate,PaymentCardTypeId, PaymentCardHolderTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.PaymentCard WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)

-- CCD --
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM TEMP_CustomerAccountSK)  AS CustomerAccountSK
,DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BCA.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator             
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
INTO DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD   
FROM
TEMP_CCD BCA
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BCA.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = DDA.SourceSystemCode AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CustomerAccountPaymentCard BCAPC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAPC.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN PaymentCard BPC ON BCAPC.PaymentCardId = BPC.PaymentCardId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT ON BPC.PaymentCardHolderTypeId = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeId AND DDAHT.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchId = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DimCustomerAccount_DELTA_CCD') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DimCustomerAccount_DELTA_CCD;
END;

WITH
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CONVERT(bigint,CustomerSK)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerID)
    ,CONVERT(bigint,AccountSK)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountID)
    ,CONVERT(int,AccountHolderTypeSK)
    ,CONVERT(int,BankSK)
    ,CONVERT(int,BranchSK)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,ShareIndicator)             
    )) HASHROW, CustomerID, AccountID, BankSK,  SourceSystemCode, AccountHolderTypeSK
    FROM DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CONVERT(bigint,CustomerSK)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerID)
    ,CONVERT(bigint,AccountSK)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountID)
    ,CONVERT(int,AccountHolderTypeSK)
    ,CONVERT(int,BankSK)
    ,CONVERT(int,BranchSK)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,ShareIndicator)   
    )) HASHROW, CustomerID, AccountID, BankSK,  SourceSystemCode, AccountHolderTypeSK
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 and SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountHolderTypeSK,TGT.AccountHolderTypeSK) AS AccountHolderTypeSK
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
AND SRC.AccountHolderTypeSK = TGT.AccountHolderTypeSK
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.HASHROW IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO DW.TEMP_DW_DimCustomerAccount_DELTA_CCD FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DimCustomerAccount_DELTA_CCD DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  
AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
 AND DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID 
  AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = DELTA.SourceSystemCode
  AND TGT.AccountHolderTypeSK = DELTA.AccountHolderTypeSK
 AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
 AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK 
 AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
  AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
    AND SRC.AccountHolderTypeSK = TGT.AccountHolderTypeSK
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 and TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD';

INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomerAccount (
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,CustomerID
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,ShareIndicator
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT 
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,SRC.CustomerID
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,SRC.AccountHolderTypeSK
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,Convert(varchar,ShareIndicator) as ShareIndicator
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_CCD SRC
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DimCustomerAccount_DELTA_CCD DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId 
 AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK 
 AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID 
  AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode 
   AND DELTA.AccountHolderTypeSK = SRC.AccountHolderTypeSK 
 AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP;
END;

WITH TEMP_CustomerAccountSK AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomerAccount
)
--FOR DEP FILTER
,CustomerAccountParticipation_DEP AS (
    SELECT distinct * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP') AND (PeriodEndDate = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000' OR PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000')  
    AND DeletedIndicator = 'N' AND VerifiedIndicator = 'Y'
)
,

FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION 
AS(
    SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication A
	JOIN (SELECT FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId,FcbsApplicationId, SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication9 GROUP BY FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, FcbsApplicationId, SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.FinancialProductId = B.FinancialProductId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode AND A.FcbsApplicationId = B.FcbsApplicationId  AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
)
,
CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory AS (
    SELECT A.* FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory A
    JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId,RecordTypeId,SerialNumber,MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountid,RecordTypeId,SerialNumber,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode) B ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId
    AND A.SerialNumber = B.SerialNumber AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM TEMP_CustomerAccountSK)  AS CustomerAccountSK
,* FROM (


--FOR DEP FILTER
SELECT DISTINCT 
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
CustomerAccountParticipation_DEP  BCAP
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,PeriodEndDate, ProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode from  BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') CAFP ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId AND CAFP.PeriodEndDate IS NULL
LEFT JOIN FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,CAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId, CoreCustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode from BNKM.Customer) BC ON BCAP.CoreCustomerId = BC.CoreCustomerId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BC.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory BCAPAS ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCAPAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAPAS.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAP.SerialNumber = BCAPAS.SerialNumber
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT  ON BCAPAS.RecordTypeId = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeID AND DDB.BankSK = DDAHT.BankSK AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DDAHT.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId, CustomerId,BranchID,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode from BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNT) BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchID = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')


    ) A
)

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CUSTOMERACCOUNT_LNS') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_LNS;
END;


WITH TEMP_CustomerAccountSK AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomerAccount  
)

-- FRO LNS FILTER
, CustomerAccountParticipation_LNS AS (
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('LNS') AND (PeriodEndDate IS NULL OR PeriodEndDate = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000' OR PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000')
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM TEMP_CustomerAccountSK)  AS CustomerAccountSK
,* FROM (

 -- LNS --
SELECT DISTINCT
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
CustomerAccountParticipation_LNS  BCAP
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId, CoreCustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode from BNKM.Customer)  BC ON BCAP.CoreCustomerId = BC.CoreCustomerId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BC.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId, RecordTypeId, SerialNumber, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode from BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory) BCAPAS ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCAPAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAPAS.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAP.SerialNumber = BCAPAS.SerialNumber
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT  ON BCAPAS.RecordTypeId = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeID AND DDB.BankSK = DDAHT.BankSK AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DDAHT.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId, CustomerId,BranchID,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode from BNKM.CustomerAccount)BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchID = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE DDA.SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL

    ) A
)

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CUSTOMERACCOUNT_SEC') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_SEC;
END;


WITH TEMP_CustomerAccountSK AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomerAccount  
)

, CustomerAccountParticipation_SEC AS (
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC' AND PeriodEndDate IS NULL
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM TEMP_CustomerAccountSK)  AS CustomerAccountSK
,* FROM (

-- SEC --
SELECT DISTINCT
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BCAP.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,BCAP.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM
CustomerAccountParticipation_SEC BCAP
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BCAP.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT ON BCAP.LinkCode = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeID  AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DDAHT.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId, CustomerId,BranchID, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode from BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchID = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1
    ) A
)

WITH CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory AS (
    SELECT A.* FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory A
    JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId,RecordTypeId,SerialNumber,MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountid,RecordTypeId,SerialNumber,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode) B ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId
    AND A.SerialNumber = B.SerialNumber AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
   
)

AS(

,CAP.DeletedIndicator AS DeletedIndicator
,CAP.PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
